
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20050097" title="发布于 2026-05-16 06:54">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">16. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate多模态应用实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>多模态 AI 是具备全感官交互能力的智能系统，集感知、理解、内容生成于一体，全面支持文本、图片、音频、视频等多类型信息的输入输出。</p>
<p>喜欢看视频的，请看<a class="link-info" title="《16. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate多模态应用实战》" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1if5R6HE8D/" rel="noopener nofollow">《16. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate多模态应用实战》</a></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260515113535742-1538064060.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在实际开发过程中，<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="LangChain" data-pretit="langchain">LangChain框架为多模态交互提供了便捷的支持，其中ChatPromptTemplate组件就原生具备多模态消息格式化的能力，无需额外进行复杂的配置，就能轻松对接多类型输入，大大降低了多模态应用的开发门槛。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260515113601139-1308044358.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;实际使用时，我们可以以图片模态为例熟悉具体用法，需要说明的是，图片模态的调用逻辑和写法，与其他模态完全一致，掌握一种就能举一反三，无需重复学习不同模态的调用方式。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260515113619106-1750242105.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;该模板在参数注入上也具备很高的灵活性，支持将图片的URL链接、<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="Base64" data-pretit="base64">Base64编码，以及本地文件路径等多种形式，作为参数动态注入到模板中，适配不同的开发场景需求，无论是在线图片还是本地图片，都能轻松处理。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>prompt_template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是专业的多模态内容分析助手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用中文简短描述图片内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{image_url}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
    ]}
])
prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt_template.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">图片地址</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>了解完基础用法后，就进入实战环节，我们可以通过具体的开发案例，感受多模态AI的实际应用价值，将理论知识转化为可落地的功能。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate
 
prompt_template </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是专业的多模态内容分析助手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用中文简短描述图片内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{image_url}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
    ]}
])
prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt_template.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">图片地址</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)
res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(res.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>在实战中，我们可以将图片识别这一核心功能，集成到基于<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="PySide6" data-pretit="pyside6">PySide6开发的AI应用界面中，最终实现对图片中文字、链接等信息的精准识别，让应用具备更实用的交互能力，满足日常开发中的实际需求。完整代码看<a class="link-info" title="《16. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate多模态应用实战》" href="https://www.toutiao.com/article/7639939985625465350/" rel="noopener nofollow">《16. LangChain ChatPromptTemplate多模态应用实战》</a>。</span></p>
